This easy purée is packed with fiber and flavor: 💛Ingredients: 4 apples, peeled and chopped 5 Agen prunes, soaked in hot water for 10 min 1/4 cup water A pinch of cinnamon Instructions: 1. In a small pot, cook chopped apples with water and cinnamon for 15 minutes. 2. Add soaked Agen prunes after removing the pits. 3. Blend until smooth.
